chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"The supplication of the fasting person is answered at the time of breaking the fast."
ai.seo_question: When is the du'a of a fasting person especially answered?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the fasting person's du'a holds a special station at the moment of iftar. It highlights a blessed time for turning to Allah with hope, sincerity, and devotion during the act of worship of sawm.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The supplication of the fasting person is answered at the time of breaking the fast."
